title: Bug Hunt: Storage Class Pitfalls in Non-Blocking LED Blinker
description:
Embedded systems must never use blocking `delay_ms()` loops because they freeze communication stacks and user interface updates.

Instead, non-blocking state machines poll `current_tick`.

### Bugs Fixed:
1. `static uint32_t last_toggle` preserves the timestamp of the last toggle.
2. `static uint8_t led_state` persists pin state across loop invocations.
3. `(current_tick - last_toggle) >= interval_ticks` cleanly handles unsigned 32-bit tick wrap.
hint: Non-blocking timers are the core foundation of cooperative super-loops in real-time embedded systems.
